an5.149:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti
an5.149:1.3: kammārāmatā bhassārāmatā niddārāmatā saṃgaṇikārāmatā yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ na paccavekkhati
an5.149:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno parihānāya saṃvattanti.
an5.149:2.1: pañcime bhikkhave dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattanti
an5.149:2.3: na kammārāmatā na bhassārāmatā na niddārāmatā na saṃgaṇikārāmatā yathāvimuttaṃ cittaṃ paccavekkhati
an5.149:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā samayavimuttassa bhikkhuno aparihānāya saṃvattantīti.
